AT2026-10-18#
party document Parliamentary intervention

Wofür ist Minister Karner eigentlich zuständig?

FPÖ parliamentary group leader Christian Hafenecker criticized ÖVP Interior Minister Gerhard Karner after his testimony in the Pilnacek investigation committee, accusing him of organized irresponsibility and claiming the minister was not included in his own ministry's leadership chat group and had no knowledge of key developments in his department.

Source metadataAI-assisted screening and summaryAI translationNot human-validated
Zu den meisten Fragen hatte der Minister schlicht keine Wahrnehmung. Wo er doch etwas wusste, war es nach eigenen Worten lediglich 'rudimentär'. Und das bei einem der brisantesten Fälle in seinem eigenen Ressort!
On most questions the minister simply had no awareness. Where he did know something, it was in his own words merely 'rudimentary'. And this on one of the most explosive cases in his own department!
Christian Hafenecker
Dort laufen die Informationen zusammen, dort wird koordiniert, aber der Minister ist nicht dabei?
That's where the information comes together, that's where coordination happens, but the minister is not part of it?
Christian Hafenecker

AT2026-10-17#
party document Public statement

Pensionsdebatte weit abseits der Realität

FPÖ social affairs spokesperson Dagmar Belakowitsch criticized AMS chief Johannes Kopf's call for raising the pension age, arguing it ignores reality and that raising women's pension age has already increased unemployment in that group.

Source metadataAI-assisted screening and summaryAI translationNot human-validated
nicht zielführend und gingen an der Lebensrealität vieler Menschen vorbei
not goal-oriented and missed the lived reality of many people
Dagmar Belakowitsch
Kopf hat seit zwanzig Jahren bewiesen, dass er weder die realen Folgen der unkontrollierten Zuwanderung noch die Folgen der hohen Lohnnebenkosten für ältere Arbeitnehmer auch nur ansatzweise verstanden hat.
Kopf has proven for twenty years that he has not even begun to understand either the real consequences of uncontrolled immigration or the consequences of high wage costs for older workers.
Dagmar Belakowitsch

AT2026-10-16#
party document Public statement

Energiepreis-Tsunami überrollt Österreich – Verlierer-Koalition schaut tatenlos zu

FPÖ deputy club chair Dagmar Belakowitsch criticized the governing coalition for inaction as heating oil prices rose 63 percent and fuel prices nearly 35 percent, calling for tax cuts on energy and fuel and advocating for new elections with Herbert Kickl as chancellor.

Source metadataAI-assisted screening and summaryAI translationNot human-validated
Diese Zahlen geben Zeugnis vom Versagen der schwarz-rot-pinken Verlierer-Koalition. Während die Regierung tatenlos zusieht, erleben die Österreicher eine Kostenlawine nach der anderen. Der Preis für Heizöl explodiert um unfassbare 63 Prozent, der Sprit wird um fast 35 Prozent teurer. Der wöchentliche Einkauf kostet die Menschen bereits sechs Prozent mehr. Das ist keine abstrakte Statistik, das ist die brutale und kalte Enteignung der arbeitenden Bevölkerung, der Familien und unserer Pensionisten
These numbers bear witness to the failure of the black-red-pink loser coalition. While the government looks on inactively, Austrians are experiencing one cost avalanche after another. The price of heating oil explodes by an unbelievable 63 percent, fuel becomes almost 35 percent more expensive. Weekly shopping already costs people six percent more. This is not an abstract statistic, this is the brutal and cold expropriation of the working population, families and our pensioners
Dagmar Belakowitsch
Diese Regierung ist ein Brandbeschleuniger für die Armut im Land. Sie treibt die Preise durch ihre ideologiegetriebene Klimapolitik und ihre Untätigkeit künstlich in die Höhe.
This government is an accelerant for poverty in the country. It artificially drives up prices through its ideology-driven climate policy and its inaction.
Dagmar Belakowitsch

Darüber kann auch PR-Show nicht hinwegtäuschen: ÖVP Mitarchitekt des EU-Bürokratie-Molochs

FPÖ foreign policy spokesperson Susanne Fürst criticized the ÖVP as co-architect of EU bureaucracy, rejected proposed EU budget increases of up to two trillion euros, demanded no additional payments to Brussels or Ukraine, and called for Austrian tax money to be used domestically instead.

Source metadataAI-assisted screening and summaryAI translationNot human-validated
Dass sich die ÖVP jetzt dafür abfeiert, dass die Wahnsinnspläne für 2.500 neue EU-Verwaltungsposten anscheinend verworfen wurden, ist doch an Scheinheiligkeit nicht zu überbieten. Der schon jetzt zum Bersten aufgeblähte EU-Apparat ist nämlich auch das Ergebnis der seit Jahrzehnten gelebten Unterwürfigkeit der ÖVP gegenüber allen Brüsseler Begehrlichkeiten. Diese Partei steht daher nicht für den Abbau der überbordenden Bürokratie in der EU, sondern ist deren Mitarchitekt!
That the ÖVP is now celebrating itself for the fact that the insane plans for 2,500 new EU administrative posts have apparently been discarded is hypocrisy beyond compare. The already bursting EU apparatus is namely also the result of decades of ÖVP subservience to all Brussels demands. This party therefore does not stand for reducing excessive EU bureaucracy, but is its co-architect!
Susanne Fürst
Zwei Billionen Euro Budget will die EU-Kommission, 1,83 Billionen Euro sieht der Vorschlag des irischen EU-Ratsvorsitzes vor. Zu stemmen wären diese gigantischen Summen vor allem von Nettozahler-Ländern wie Österreich – das heißt, von den Steuerzahlern. Das muss verhindert werden!
The EU Commission wants a two trillion euro budget, the Irish EU Council presidency proposal foresees 1.83 trillion euros. These gigantic sums would have to be borne primarily by net contributor countries like Austria – that is, by taxpayers. This must be prevented!
Susanne Fürst

Während sich der ÖVP-Bauernbund mit den Zwangsbeiträgen der fleißigen Landwirte die eigenen Taschen füllt und fürstliche Zusatzpensionen in Höhe von fast 2.000 Euro monatlich sichert, beträgt die durchschnittliche monatliche Bruttopension eines Bauern in Österreich gerade einmal rund 1.300 Euro.

CH2026-10-15#
party document Mobilisation or protest

FAQ – Initiative pour la priorité au logement à Genève

The Geneva Citizens' Movement is collecting signatures for a cantonal legislative initiative requiring subsidized housing applicants to have resided in Geneva for 5 consecutive years out of the last 10 (instead of 4 out of 8), with a deadline of December 8, 2026 to gather 4,272 valid signatures.

Source metadataAI-assisted screening and summaryAI translationNot human-validated
En 2022, les Genevois ont soutenu une loi du MCG pour renforcer la priorité aux personnes qui habitent à Genève. Pourtant, le Conseil d'État a ensuite introduit des exceptions et des dérogations qui permettent de contourner cette règle, sans nouvelle décision du peuple ni accord du Parlement.
In 2022, Geneva residents supported an MCG law to strengthen priority for people who live in Geneva. However, the State Council then introduced exceptions and derogations that allow this rule to be circumvented, without a new decision by the people or agreement from Parliament.
Geneva Citizens' Movement
Nous voulons modifier la loi pour que les personnes qui demandent un logement subventionné aient résidé à Genève pendant 5 années consécutives au cours des 10 dernières années, au lieu de 4 années sur les 8 dernières.
We want to modify the law so that people applying for subsidized housing have resided in Geneva for 5 consecutive years out of the last 10 years, instead of 4 years out of the last 8.
Geneva Citizens' Movement

CY2026-10-16#
party document Policy proposal

Οι χορηγίες για ενεργειακή αναβάθμιση να φτάνουν σε όσους τις έχουν περισσότερο ανάγκη – Οι προτάσεις του ΑΚΕΛ

AKEL General Secretary Stefanos Stefanou submitted a letter to the Minister of Energy, Commerce and Industry proposing improvements to the 2026 Housing Energy Upgrade Grant Scheme, including advance payment mechanisms, a separate scheme for energy-poor households with up to 100% subsidies, full coverage of energy audits for vulnerable households, and replacement of first-come-first-served allocation with social and energy-based scoring.

Source metadataAI-assisted screening and summaryAI translationNot human-validated
Η βασική μας θέση είναι ότι η ενεργειακή αναβάθμιση των κατοικιών πρέπει να αποτελέσει μέρος μιας ολοκληρωμένης πολιτικής αντιμετώπισης της ενεργειακής φτώχειας και όχι να περιορίζεται σε ένα σχέδιο επιδότησης επενδύσεων για όσους έχουν ήδη την οικονομική δυνατότητα να τις πραγματοποιήσουν.
Our basic position is that the energy upgrading of homes must be part of a comprehensive policy to address energy poverty and not be limited to a subsidy scheme for investments for those who already have the financial capacity to carry them out.
Stefanos Stefanou
Θεωρούμε ότι η επιτυχία ενός σχεδίου ενεργειακής αναβάθμισης δεν πρέπει να αξιολογείται μόνο με βάση το ύψος του διαθέσιμου προϋπολογισμού ή τον αριθμό των κατοικιών που θα αναβαθμιστούν. Πρέπει πρωτίστως να αξιολογείται με βάση το κατά πόσο η κρατική στήριξη φτάνει σε εκείνους που τη χρειάζονται περισσότερο.
We believe that the success of an energy upgrade scheme should not be evaluated only on the basis of the amount of available budget or the number of homes to be upgraded. It must primarily be evaluated on the basis of whether state support reaches those who need it most.
Stefanos Stefanou

party document Parliamentary intervention

Δημόσιες συγκοινωνίες που δεν εξυπηρετούν τις ανάγκες της κοινωνίας

AKEL MP Valentinos Fakontis issued a written statement criticizing government public transport policies in Nicosia following an Audit Service report, demanding immediate comprehensive upgrades including more frequent routes, modern infrastructure, affordable tickets, universal accessibility, and strict oversight.

Συνάντηση ΑΚΕΛ με το Κλαδικό Συμβούλιο Λειτουργών Κοινωνικών Υπηρεσιών της Παγκύπριας Συντεχνίας ΙΣΟΤΗΤΑ

AKEL delegation led by Health Sector Head Dr. Chrysanthos Georgiou met with the Sectoral Council of Social Services Officers of the Pan-Cyprian Union ISOTITA to discuss chronic problems in Social Welfare Services, demanding immediate staffing increases, workload limits per officer, removal of administrative burdens, and rejecting the government's practice of outsourcing services to private programs.

Source metadataAI-assisted screening and summaryAI translationNot human-validated
Το ΑΚΕΛ τονίζει ότι η πολιτεία οφείλει να δώσει άμεσες και ουσιαστικές λύσεις, αφού τα προβλήματα που καταγράφονται απαιτούν άμεση και αποφασιστική παρέμβαση.
AKEL emphasizes that the state must provide immediate and substantial solutions, since the problems recorded require immediate and decisive intervention.
AKEL
Η πρακτική της κυβέρνησης να καταφεύγει στην «εύκολη λύση» της αγοράς υπηρεσιών μέσω προγραμμάτων δεν αποτελεί πολιτική κοινωνικής προστασίας των ευάλωτων ομάδων, αλλά μετακύλιση ευθύνης και σταδιακή ιδιωτικοποίηση κρίσιμων υπηρεσιών που αφορούν ευάλωτες ομάδες.
The government's practice of resorting to the 'easy solution' of purchasing services through programs does not constitute a social protection policy for vulnerable groups, but a shifting of responsibility and gradual privatization of critical services concerning vulnerable groups.
AKEL

party document Public statement

Η κυπριακή Βουλή δεν μπορεί να μετατρέπεται σε λόμπι προώθησης των συμφερόντων του Ισραήλ

AKEL condemns the formation of a parliamentary group by DISY, DIKO and ELAM in cooperation with the Israel Allies Foundation and the creation of a Cypriot branch of Transatlantic Friends of Israel, calling it an unprecedented lobby for a foreign country's interests within parliament and criticizing government support for Israel while Cyprus seeks international pressure on Turkey regarding occupation.

Source metadataAI-assisted screening and summaryAI translationNot human-validated
Η συγκρότηση κοινοβουλευτικής ομάδας από ΔΗΣΥ, ΔΗΚΟ και ΕΛΑΜ σε συνεργασία με το Israel Allies Foundation και η δημιουργία κυπριακού παραρτήματος του Transatlantic Friends of Israel (TFI) αποτελούν εξαιρετικά προκλητικές ενέργειες.
The formation of a parliamentary group by DISY, DIKO and ELAM in cooperation with the Israel Allies Foundation and the creation of a Cypriot branch of Transatlantic Friends of Israel (TFI) constitute extremely provocative actions.
Progressive Party of Working People
Πώς συμβιβάζεται η συμμετοχή Κύπριων βουλευτών σε τέτοιες πρωτοβουλίες με τον αγώνα μας για τερματισμό της τουρκικής κατοχής και του εποικισμού, ο οποίος στηρίζεται στο διεθνές δίκαιο και στα ψηφίσματα του ΟΗΕ;
How is the participation of Cypriot MPs in such initiatives compatible with our struggle to end the Turkish occupation and colonization, which is based on international law and UN resolutions?
Progressive Party of Working People

Τι άλλα στοιχεία χρειάζεται η κυβέρνηση για να πάρει ουσιαστικά μέτρα;

AKEL press spokesman Charis Polykarpou issued a written statement criticizing the government's insufficient measures against rising costs and demanding immediate policy interventions including targeted fuel subsidies, vehicle license fee reductions, market oversight, heating allowances expansion, permanent 5% VAT on electricity, and energy upgrade schemes with social criteria.

Source metadataAI-assisted screening and summaryAI translationNot human-validated
Τα στοιχεία που ανακοίνωσε, χθες, η Στατιστική Υπηρεσία σε σχέση με τις αυξήσεις σε τρόφιμα και βασικά αγαθά τεκμηριώνουν ότι η ακρίβεια έχει γονατίσει νοικοκυριά και μικρομεσαίες επιχειρήσεις.
The data announced yesterday by the Statistical Service regarding increases in food and basic goods document that high prices have brought households and small and medium-sized enterprises to their knees.
Χάρης Πολυκάρπου
Η κυβέρνηση του Νίκου Χριστοδουλίδη πρέπει να αντιληφθεί ότι σε μια οικονομία που ευημερεί δεν αρκεί μόνο να καταγράφονται δημοσιονομικά πλεονάσματα.
The government of Nikos Christodoulidis must understand that in a prosperous economy it is not enough to merely record fiscal surpluses.
Χάρης Πολυκάρπου

Το ΑΚΕΛ δίπλα στο Χαμπή Τσαγκάρη | Να διαφυλαχτεί ο πολιτιστικός πλούτος της Κύπρου

AKEL expressed support for Hambis Tsangaris and called for an immediate solution to ensure the continued operation of the Printmaking School and Museum in Platanisteia, after initiating contact with the Minister of Interior who committed to actions for resolution.

Source metadataAI-assisted screening and summaryAI translationNot human-validated
Ο Χαμπής, μία από τις σπουδαιότερες προσωπικότητες του πολιτισμού που έχει αναδείξει η Κύπρος, μέσα από τις δεκαετίες λειτουργίας της Σχολής και του Μουσείου, έχει συμβάλει καθοριστικά στην αποκέντρωση της πολιτιστικής δημιουργίας, στην ανάδειξη της υπαίθρου και στην προαγωγή της πλούσιας πολιτιστικής μας κληρονομιάς.
Hambis, one of the most important cultural figures that Cyprus has produced, through the decades of operation of the School and Museum, has contributed decisively to the decentralization of cultural creation, the promotion of the countryside and the advancement of our rich cultural heritage.
AKEL
η Πολιτεία έχει καθήκον να διαφυλάξει τόσο το έργο που επιτελείται, όσο και τον πολιτιστικό «θησαυρό» που φιλοξενείται στις εγκαταστάσεις στην Πλατανίστεια.
The State has a duty to safeguard both the work being carried out and the cultural 'treasure' housed in the facilities in Platanisteia.
AKEL

Όχι σε άλλες κεραίες στο Ακρωτήρι

AKEL MP Marina Nikolaou opposed the installation of new British military antennas in Akrotiri after a Parliamentary Environment Committee session, calling for scientific studies on environmental and health impacts and reiterating the party's position for abolition of British bases in Cyprus.

Source metadataAI-assisted screening and summaryAI translationNot human-validated
Το ΑΚΕΛ ανέκαθεν υπογράμμιζε ότι η παρουσία στρατιωτικών βάσεων στην επικράτεια της Κυπριακής Δημοκρατίας, είναι κακό κατάλοιπο της αποικιοκρατίας και πρέπει να καταργηθούν.
AKEL has always emphasized that the presence of military bases on the territory of the Republic of Cyprus is a bad remnant of colonialism and they must be abolished.
Marina Nikolaou
Ζητήσαμε να εκπονηθούν επιστημονικές και περιβαλλοντικές μελέτες, οι οποίες θα εξετάζουν όχι μόνο τις επιπτώσεις κάθε νέας εγκατάστασης ξεχωριστά, αλλά και τις σωρευτικές επιπτώσεις του συνόλου των υφιστάμενων και νέων υποδομών.
We requested that scientific and environmental studies be conducted, which will examine not only the impacts of each new installation separately, but also the cumulative impacts of all existing and new infrastructure.

CY2026-10-07#
party document Public statement

Η κυβέρνηση να γίνει προστάτης των συμφερόντων της κοινωνίας, όχι δικηγόρος των εταιρειών καυσίμων

AKEL spokesperson Charis Polykarpou criticized the Christodoulides government for failing to control fuel prices and demanded immediate measures including a request to the EU to abolish double taxation on fuel, targeted mobility subsidies, and reduced circulation fees.

Source metadataAI-assisted screening and summaryAI translationNot human-validated
Είναι ένα πράγμα η κυβέρνηση Νίκου Χριστοδουλίδη να χαρακτηρίζεται από αδυναμία για αποτελεσματική αντιμετώπιση της ακρίβειας, είναι πολύ χειρότερο να προκαλεί συνειδητά την κοινωνία, δίνοντας άφεση αμαρτιών στις εταιρείες καυσίμων στην Κύπρο.
It is one thing for the Nikos Christodoulides government to be characterized by an inability to effectively address high prices, it is much worse to consciously provoke society by giving absolution to fuel companies in Cyprus.
Χάρης Πολυκάρπου
Χρειάζεται η κυβέρνηση να προχωρήσει σε υποβολή αιτήματος στην Ευρωπαϊκή Ένωση για κατάργηση της διπλής φορολογίας στα καύσιμα και μαζί να λάβει έκτακτα μέτρα στήριξης της κοινωνίας που περιλαμβάνουν την εισαγωγή στοχευμένου επιδόματος μετακίνησης και μείωση των αδειών κυκλοφορίας
The government needs to proceed with submitting a request to the European Union for the abolition of double taxation on fuel and together take emergency support measures for society that include the introduction of a targeted mobility allowance and reduction of circulation fees
Χάρης Πολυκάρπου

CY2026-10-07#
party document Public statement

Σχέδιο Αειφόρου Ανάπτυξης Ακάμα: Ένα ακόμα μνημείο αποτυχίας της διακυβέρνησης Ν. Χριστοδουλίδη

AKEL criticizes the Christodoulidis government over failures in planning and implementing the Akamas National Forest Park Sustainable Development Plan, citing an Audit Office report documenting environmental damage, cost overruns, and potential criminal conduct that may be referred to the Attorney General.

Source metadataAI-assisted screening and summaryAI translationNot human-validated
Η αποτυχία της κυβέρνησης στην προστασία του Ακάμα αποτυπώνεται από την απουσία επαρκούς προληπτικού σχεδιασμού και ελέγχων, αδυναμία οι περιβαλλοντικοί όροι να ενσωματωθούν σωστά στα σχέδια, απόκλιση των κατασκευών σε αρκετές περιπτώσεις από τους όρους/σχέδια και εκ των υστέρων αντιμετώπιση προβλημάτων που προκάλεσαν περιβαλλοντική επιβάρυνση, καθυστερήσεις και σπατάλη δημόσιων πόρων.
The government's failure to protect Akamas is reflected in the absence of adequate preventive planning and controls, inability to properly integrate environmental conditions into the plans, deviation of constructions in several cases from the terms/plans, and retrospective handling of problems that caused environmental burden, delays and waste of public resources.
Progressive Party of Working People
Ο Ακάμας είναι κοινή κληρονομιά ολόκληρης της κυπριακής κοινωνίας, χρειάζεται προστασία στην πράξη, ορθή αξιοποίηση του δημόσιου χρήματος και έργα που υπηρετούν το περιβάλλον και την κοινωνία.
Akamas is the common heritage of the entire Cypriot society, it needs protection in practice, proper utilization of public money and projects that serve the environment and society.
Progressive Party of Working People

party document Policy proposal

Ανάγκη για άμεση στήριξη και πληθυσμιακή ενίσχυση των κοινοτήτων της Τηλλυρίας – Περιοδεία ΕΛΑΜ

ELAM delegation toured Tillyria region and proposed special-status designation with incentives including reduced energy costs, housing support, and business aid to increase population and combat rural depopulation in communities of national importance.

Source metadataAI-assisted screening and summaryAI translationNot human-validated
Ως Ε.ΛΑ.Μ., στηρίζουμε την άμεση θεσμοθέτηση και επίσημη ανακήρυξη της περιοχής σε περιοχή με ειδικό καθεστώς, ώστε να εφαρμόζονται πολιτικές που όχι μόνο θα καταπολεμούν την αστυφιλία, αλλά θα συμβάλλουν ταυτόχρονα στην αύξηση του πληθυσμού των κοινοτήτων της Τηλλυρίας.
As ELAM, we support the immediate institutionalization and official declaration of the area as a region with special status, so that policies are implemented that will not only combat rural depopulation, but will simultaneously contribute to increasing the population of the Tillyria communities.
ELAM
Από πλευράς μας, θα μεταφέρουμε τις εισηγήσεις μας στην εκτελεστική εξουσία και θα συνεχίσουμε να ασκούμε πιέσεις, ώστε να διαμορφωθούν όσο το δυνατόν καλύτερες συνθήκες για τις τοπικές κοινωνίες, εις όφελος και των εθνικών μας συμφερόντων.
For our part, we will convey our proposals to the executive authority and will continue to exert pressure, so that the best possible conditions are formed for the local communities, for the benefit of our national interests as well.
ELAM

CY2026-10-16#
party document Parliamentary intervention

Άρθρο Γ. Γεάδη: Μπορεί η Κύπρος να προσφέρει στους νέους της ένα μέλλον με πραγματική προοπτική;

National Popular Front MEP Geadis Geadi questioned European Commission Executive Vice-President Roxana Mînzatu in the EMPL Committee on 12 October 2026 about quality employment and the inability of young qualified workers in Cyprus and small island states to afford housing or start families despite working, calling for decent wages and real career prospects beyond job creation.

Source metadataAI-assisted screening and summaryAI translationNot human-validated
πώς μπορούμε να μιλάμε για ποιοτικές θέσεις εργασίας, όταν ένας νέος άνθρωπος, ακόμη και με μεταπτυχιακό τίτλο, εργάζεται καθημερινά αλλά δεν μπορεί να αγοράσει κατοικία;
how can we talk about quality jobs when a young person, even with a postgraduate degree, works every day but cannot buy a home?
Geadis Geadi
Η δημιουργία νέων θέσεων εργασίας είναι αναγκαία, αλλά δεν αρκεί από μόνη της. Χρειαζόμαστε αξιοπρεπείς μισθούς, πραγματικές δυνατότητες επαγγελματικής εξέλιξης και θέσεις που ανταποκρίνονται στις γνώσεις και στις δεξιότητες των εργαζομένων.
The creation of new jobs is necessary, but it is not enough by itself. We need decent wages, real opportunities for professional development and positions that correspond to the knowledge and skills of workers.
Geadis Geadi

party document Parliamentary intervention

Μ. Πελεκάνος: «Προτεραιότητα στις ευάλωτες ομάδες μέσω κριτηρίων για προώθηση της ηλεκτροκίνησης»

ELAM MP Marios Pelekanos proposed criteria to prioritize vulnerable population groups in the distribution of a 20 million euro budget for promoting electric mobility during the examination of the Ministry of Transport budget, and the Minister responded positively to the proposal.

Source metadataAI-assisted screening and summaryAI translationNot human-validated
Αναφορικά με το κονδύλι ύψους 20 εκατομμυρίων ευρώ, το οποίο περιλαμβάνεται στον προϋπολογισμό για την προώθηση της ηλεκτροκίνησης, επισήμανε την εισήγηση που καταθέσαμε για τον καθορισμό συγκεκριμένων κριτηρίων, ώστε να δίνεται προτεραιότητα στις ευάλωτες ομάδες του πληθυσμού.

Τόνισε ότι η Υπουργός Μεταφορών ανταποκρίθηκε θετικά στην εισήγησή μας, σημειώνοντας ότι θα αναμένουμε να ακούσουμε περισσότερα μετά την ψήφιση των προϋπολογισμών.
He stressed that the Minister of Transport responded positively to our proposal, noting that we will wait to hear more after the voting on the budgets.
Marios Pelekanos

CY2026-10-16#
party document Parliamentary intervention

Σ. Ιωάννου: «Θέσαμε σειρά ζητημάτων για τον προϋπολογισμό του Υπουργείου Μεταφορών»

ELAM parliamentary spokesperson and chair of the Transport Committee raised multiple issues during the Ministry of Transport budget examination, including taxi legislation modernization, scooter regulations, public transport staffing shortages, Larnaca port and marina matters, airport compensation measures for municipalities, and subsidies for large families to purchase vehicles.

Source metadataAI-assisted screening and summaryAI translationNot human-validated
Ως Ε.ΛΑ.Μ., θέσαμε σειρά ερωτημάτων και ζητημάτων που μας απασχολούν έντονα και για τα οποία είτε καταθέσαμε προτάσεις νόμου είτε έχουν εγγραφεί αυτεπάγγελτα στην αρμόδια επιτροπή.
As ELAM, we raised a series of questions and issues that concern us intensely and for which we have either submitted legislative proposals or they have been registered ex officio in the competent committee.
Sotiris Ioannou
Μετά τις απαντήσεις που έχουμε λάβει, θα εξετάσουμε τον προϋπολογισμό ξεχωριστά και θα κάνουμε τις αναγκαίες παρεμβάσεις κατά τη διαδικασία ψήφισής του.
After the answers we have received, we will examine the budget separately and will make the necessary interventions during the voting process.
Sotiris Ioannou

Whoever is an enemy of Turkey and the Muslim Brotherhood is an ally in the struggle of Cyprus and Hellenism.
National Popular Front (ELAM)

The National Popular Front (ELAM) issued a statement warning of demographic change in Cyprus due to declining births among Cypriot mothers and rising births among mothers from third countries, proposing legislative measures including revised child benefit criteria excluding third-country nationals with refugee status, financial support for Greek Cypriot families, and increased VAT thresholds for first homes.

The state is called upon to support Cypriot families in practice, before we become a minority in our own Homeland.
National Popular Front
Η επιβίωση του κυπριακού ελληνισμού αποτελεί υπαρξιακό ζήτημα και ως τέτοιο θα πρέπει να βρίσκεται στην κορυφή των προτεραιοτήτων της Πολιτείας.
The survival of Cypriot Hellenism is an existential issue and as such should be at the top of the State's priorities.
National Popular Front

Ο ξυλοδαρμός από τους βασανιστές μας, που ήταν δύο αξιωματικοί της αστυνομίας, ένας Άγγλος και ένας Τούρκος και αρκετοί Άγγλοι στρατιώτες, συνεχιζόταν μια σε μένα, μια στον Νικολή, έξω από τη Μόρφου προς τη θάλασσα, κοντά σε ένα αυλάκι με νερό, όπου μας έριχναν, όταν λιποθυμούσαμε.
The beating by our torturers, who were two police officers, one English and one Turkish and several English soldiers, continued alternating between me and Nikolis, outside Morphou towards the sea, near a ditch with water, where they threw us when we fainted.
Antonis Papaevripidis
Σε μια στροφή του δρόμου ο Νικολής έγειρε πάνω στην πόρτα, η οποία άνοιξε, αφήνοντας το σώμα του να κρέμεται κατατσακισμένο, ταλαιπωρημένο, μη μπορώντας να κάμει την παραμικρή προσπάθεια, για να κρατηθεί.
At a turn in the road Nikolis leaned on the door, which opened, leaving his body hanging battered, tormented, unable to make the slightest effort to hold on.
Antonis Papaevripidis

party document Public statement

Übergewinnsteuer: Merz drückt sich vor der Verantwortung

Die Linke criticizes the German federal government and CDU leader Friedrich Merz for failing to push for an excess profits tax on energy companies at the EU summit, accusing them of deflecting responsibility to Brussels while energy corporations earn billions as citizens struggle with high energy prices.

Source metadataAI-assisted screening and summaryAI translationNot human-validated
Die Bundesregierung verweist bei der Übergewinnsteuer immer wieder auf die europäische Ebene. Doch offensichtlich geht es ihr dabei vor allem darum, auf nationaler Ebene nicht selbst tätig werden zu müssen. Gleichzeitig ist nicht erkennbar, dass Friedrich Merz auf europäischer Ebene sein politisches Gewicht in die Waagschale wirft, um eine Übergewinnsteuer durchzusetzen.
The federal government repeatedly refers to the European level regarding the excess profits tax. But obviously it is primarily concerned with not having to take action itself at the national level. At the same time, it is not apparent that Friedrich Merz is throwing his political weight into the balance at the European level to push through an excess profits tax.
Ines Schwerdtner
Die Mineralölkonzerne scheffeln weiter Milliarden an Übergewinnen, während die Menschen an den Zapfsäulen bluten.
The oil companies continue to rake in billions in excess profits while people bleed at the gas pumps.
Ines Schwerdtner

DE2026-10-15#
party document Public statement

Mietsteigerungen: Debatte um Mietendeckel muss geführt werden

Die Linke party chair Luigi Pantisano demands the federal government introduce a nationwide rent cap (Mietendeckel) in response to third-quarter 2026 rent increases of 1.2 percent, the highest since early 2025.

Source metadataAI-assisted screening and summaryAI translationNot human-validated
Die Mieten kennen seit Jahren nur eine Richtung: nach oben. Was die Immobilienkonzerne als Rendite verbuchen, fehlt den Menschen am Monatsende zum Leben. Die Bundesregierung muss sich entscheiden auf welcher Seite sie steht: auf der Seite der Immobilienkonzerne, oder auf der Seite der Mieterinnen und Mieter.
Rents have known only one direction for years: upward. What real estate corporations book as profit is missing from people's lives at the end of the month. The federal government must decide which side it is on: on the side of real estate corporations, or on the side of tenants.
Luigi Pantisano
Wohnen ist ein Grundrecht und darf kein Luxus sein. Es ist höchste Zeit, dass die Bundesregierung die Interessen der Mieterinnen und Mieter über die Profite der Immobilienkonzerne stellt.
Housing is a fundamental right and must not be a luxury. It is high time that the federal government puts the interests of tenants above the profits of real estate corporations.
Luigi Pantisano

Miten ihmeessä on mahdollista, että suomalainen ruoka on kuluttajalle liian kallista, mutta sen tuottaminen on viljelijälle liian huonosti kannattavaa? Jossakin tässä yhtälössä on pahasti vikaa
How on earth is it possible that Finnish food is too expensive for the consumer, but producing it is too poorly profitable for the farmer? Something is seriously wrong with this equation
Miikka Kortelainen
Ei voi olla niin, että viljelijä kantaa riskit, kuluttaja maksaa laskun ja ruokaketjun vahvimmat sanelevat ehdot. Jos markkinat eivät pysty turvaamaan kohtuuhintaista ruokaa suomalaisille ja kunnollista toimeentuloa ruoantuottajille, päättäjien tehtävä on korjata markkinoiden toimintaa.
It cannot be that the farmer bears the risks, the consumer pays the bill, and the strongest in the food chain dictate the terms. If the markets cannot ensure reasonably priced food for Finns and decent livelihoods for food producers, it is the task of decision-makers to correct the functioning of the markets.
Miikka Kortelainen

party document Policy proposal

Minja Koskela: ammattiliittojen jäsenmaksun verovähennysoikeus täytyy tuplata

Left Alliance chair Minja Koskela proposed doubling the tax deduction for trade union membership fees to increase unionisation rates and restore balance in labour relations after government reforms weakened worker power.

Source metadataAI-assisted screening and summaryAI translationNot human-validated
Ay-jäsenmaksun verovähennysoikeus pitäisi palauttaa, ja se pitäisi palauttaa tuplana. Tämä lisäisi kannusteita liittyä ammattiliittoihin ja sitä kautta vahvistaisi neuvottelukulttuuria, yhteiskunnan vakautta sekä demokratian toteutumista.
The tax deduction for trade union membership fees should be restored, and it should be restored doubled. This would increase incentives to join trade unions and thereby strengthen negotiation culture, societal stability, and the realisation of democracy.
Minja Koskela
Ensi kaudella täytyy aloittaa valtatasapainon palauttaminen. Se edellyttää, että järjestäytymisastetta nostetaan eli että yhä useampi työntekijä kuuluu ammattiliittoon.
In the next term, we must begin restoring the balance of power. This requires increasing the rate of unionisation, meaning that more and more workers belong to a trade union.
Minja Koskela

FI2026-10-16#
party document Parliamentary intervention

Johannes Yrttiaho: Käännytyslaki vaarantaa demokraattisen oikeusvaltion

Left Alliance MP Johannes Yrttiaho and Green MP Krista Mikkonen submitted a dissenting opinion in the Constitutional Law Committee opposing the extension of the so-called pushback law, arguing it violates Finland's constitutional order and binding international human rights obligations.

Source metadataAI-assisted screening and summaryAI translationNot human-validated
Käännytyslaki eli laki väliaikaisista toimenpiteistä välineellistetyn maahantulon torjumiseksi on Suomen perusoikeusjärjestelmän ja valtiosäännön vastainen. Se loukkaa räikeästi useita Suomea sitovia kansainvälisiä ihmisoikeussopimuksia
The pushback law, i.e. the law on temporary measures to counter instrumentalized immigration, is contrary to Finland's fundamental rights system and constitution. It blatantly violates several international human rights treaties binding on Finland
Johannes Yrttiaho
Kansainvälisistä ihmisoikeusvelvoitteista ei voi tehdä poikkeuksia. Valtiosopimusoikeutta koskevan Wienin sopimuksen 27 artiklan mukaan valtio ei voi vedota sisäisen oikeutensa määräyksiin perusteena valtiosopimuksen täyttämättä jättämiselle. Poikkeuslailla ei voida ratkaista ristiriitaa kansainvälisen oikeuden kanssa
No exceptions can be made to international human rights obligations. According to Article 27 of the Vienna Convention on the Law of Treaties, a state cannot invoke the provisions of its internal law as justification for its failure to perform a treaty. An exception law cannot resolve a conflict with international law
Johannes Yrttiaho

Minja Koskela: Asiakasmaksujen korotukset pakottavat pienituloiset valitsemaan ruoan ja hoidon välillä

Left Alliance MP Minja Koskela criticized the Orpo government's healthcare fee increases, stating that low-income people are being forced to choose between food and medical care, with surgical procedures being cancelled because patients cannot afford the fees.

Source metadataAI-assisted screening and summaryAI translationNot human-validated
Helsingin Sanomien mukaan HUSin sairaaloissa perutaan nyt leikkaushoitoja, koska niitä tarvitsevilla ei ole varaa asiakasmaksuihin. Tämä on pöyristyttävä tilanne hyvinvointivaltiossa ja suora seuraus Orpon hallituksen politiikasta ja Rydmanin hinnoista.
According to Helsingin Sanomat, surgical procedures are now being cancelled in HUS hospitals because those who need them cannot afford the patient fees. This is an outrageous situation in a welfare state and a direct consequence of the Orpo government's policy and Rydman's prices.
Minja Koskela
Orpon hallitus on luonut sote-Suomen, jossa kaikkein pienituloisimmat ihmiset eivät uskalla hakeutua hoitoon maksujen pelossa. Tämän kylmempää politiikkaa on vaikea keksiä.
The Orpo government has created a healthcare Finland where the very poorest people do not dare to seek treatment for fear of fees. It is hard to think of colder politics than this.
Minja Koskela

France Unbowed demands state intervention to save Fonderie de Bretagne after Europlasma failed to deliver promised mortar shells, calling for temporary nationalization and requiring Renault and Thales to place orders in exchange for public subsidies.

La France insoumise
L'État mène pourtant la politique inverse. Il soutient une raffinerie de nickel près de Bordeaux, a poussé à l'exportation du minerai destiné aux usines locales, écarte des repreneurs sans proposer d'alternative et s'apprête à faire signer le 20 octobre un protocole avec l'Union européenne qui prévoit la transformation du nickel en Europe.
The State is however pursuing the opposite policy. It supports a nickel refinery near Bordeaux, has pushed for the export of ore intended for local factories, dismisses potential buyers without proposing an alternative and is preparing to sign on October 20 a protocol with the European Union that provides for the processing of nickel in Europe.
La France insoumise

France Unbowed

Economists are telling the Chancellor today that a steady-as-she-goes budget 'is not an option'. With three in five families already cutting back on spending, and many about to see a £300 increase in their bills in January, we're challenging the government to take bold and immediate action on the cost of living. For a start, this means moving more costs off energy bills, properly funding a national home insulation scheme, clamping down on profiteering by energy companies, and rapidly scaling up cheaper, cleaner energy.
Zack Polanski

GR2026-10-11#
party document Public statement

Δύο νεκροί για τα υπερκέρδη της Motor Oil

ANTARSYA issued a statement condemning a fatal explosion at Motor Oil refineries in Agioi Theodoroi, Corinthia on 9 October 2026 that killed two workers and injured four, calling it an employer crime driven by profit maximization and demanding comprehensive labor reforms including reduced working hours, collective bargaining rights, higher minimum wage, and improved workplace safety inspections.

Source metadataAI-assisted screening and summaryAI translationNot human-validated
Αυτό δείχνει ότι οι εργασίες συντήρησης δεν πραγματοποιούνται με όρους προστασίας της ζωής και της ασφάλειας των εργαζομένων, αλλά το μόνο που ενδιαφέρει την εργοδοσία είναι να προστατεύσει τα υπερκέρδη της.
This shows that maintenance work is not carried out under terms that protect the life and safety of workers, but the only thing that interests the employer is to protect its super-profits.
Anticapitalist Left Cooperation for the Overthrow
Δεν πάει άλλο! Η εργατική τάξη δουλεύει πιο πολύ, πιο εντατικά, πιο ελαστικά και πιο κακοπληρωμένα, χαράζεται το κορμί και η ψυχή της από τη σκληρή δουλειά.
Enough is enough! The working class works more, more intensively, more flexibly and more poorly paid, its body and soul are carved up by hard work.
Anticapitalist Left Cooperation for the Overthrow

MeRA25 issued a statement demanding the immediate release of a Rouvikonas member arrested in Thessaloniki on 15 October 2025 after an intervention at a construction company known for workplace safety violations, while criticizing the government for prosecuting activists instead of employers responsible for workplace deaths.

GR2026-10-18#
party document Parliamentary intervention

Αντικαταβολή χωρίς μετρητά: Μια αδικαιολόγητη απαγόρευση εις βάρος των πολιτών

NIKH MP Andreas Voryllas opposes Article 299 of a draft bill that would ban cash payments for cash-on-delivery courier services, arguing it creates economic exclusion and demanding the provision be withdrawn or limited to transactions above 500 euros.

Source metadataAI-assisted screening and summaryAI translationNot human-validated
Η κυβέρνηση, στο όνομα της καταπολέμησης της φοροδιαφυγής, προωθεί με το άρθρο 299 του υπό διαβούλευση νομοσχεδίου την κατάργηση της δυνατότητας πληρωμής με μετρητά στις αντικαταβολές μέσω εταιρειών ταχυμεταφοράς, ανεξαρτήτως ποσού.
The government, in the name of combating tax evasion, is promoting through Article 299 of the draft bill under consultation the abolition of the possibility of cash payment for cash-on-delivery through courier companies, regardless of amount.
Andreas Voryllas
Η ΝΙΚΗ ζητεί την απόσυρση της διάταξης και τη διατήρηση της αντικαταβολής με μετρητά, τουλάχιστον για συναλλαγές έως 500 ευρώ, με υποχρεωτική έκδοση παραστατικών και αποτελεσματικούς φορολογικούς ελέγχους.
NIKH demands the withdrawal of the provision and the retention of cash-on-delivery with cash, at least for transactions up to 500 euros, with mandatory issuance of receipts and effective tax audits.
NIKH

The NIKI Corinthia regional community participated in a reception event organized by the Municipality of Corinth for Greeks adopted by American families in the 1950s-70s who returned to search for their biological families, with representative Eliza Kaminari-Strati expressing support for their efforts.

Source metadataAI-assisted screening and summaryAI translationNot human-validated
Η παρουσία μας εκεί δεν είχε απλώς τυπικό χαρακτήρα. Ήταν μια πράξη σεβασμού και συμπαράστασης προς ανθρώπους που, έπειτα από τόσα χρόνια, εξακολουθούν να αναζητούν την προσωπική και οικογενειακή τους ιστορία.
Our presence there was not merely formal in character. It was an act of respect and support towards people who, after so many years, continue to search for their personal and family history.
NIKI Corinthia
Η ΝΙΚΗ Κορινθίας στέκεται με σεβασμό δίπλα στην προσπάθειά τους να μάθουν περισσότερα για την καταγωγή τους και, όπου αυτό είναι δυνατό, να εντοπίσουν τις βιολογικές τους οικογένειες.
NIKI Corinthia stands with respect beside their effort to learn more about their origins and, where possible, to locate their biological families.
NIKI Corinthia

Επικοινωνιακά μπαλώματα από έναν αλαζόνα πρωθυπουργό σε αποδρομή

Democratic Patriotic Movement – Victory criticizes Prime Minister Kyriakos Mitsotakis following an EU Summit, attacking his government's policies on energy costs, migration, fuel subsidies, fishing industry support, and education, accusing him of communication tactics rather than substantive solutions.

Source metadataAI-assisted screening and summaryAI translationNot human-validated
Κινδυνεύει να εξαφανιστεί το ελληνικό χρώμα από τα νησιά μας και το επικίνδυνο επιτελείο του παρακολουθεί απαθέστατα μουλάδες και μουσουλμάνους να αλωνίζουν ανενόχλητοι.
The Greek character of our islands is in danger of disappearing and his dangerous staff watches apathetically as mullahs and Muslims roam undisturbed.
Democratic Patriotic Movement – Victory
Όταν η κυβέρνησή αποδημεί τις αρχές του ελληνικού Έθνους με woke ατζέντες και πολλαπλά βιβλία, ξεγελά τα παιδιά μας και τα κατευθύνει μακριά από την πατριδογνωσία, την αξία της παραδοσιακής οικογένειας και τα οδηγεί στην αποδόμηση της εθνικής και ελληνορθόδοξης ταυτότητάς μας.
When his government exiles the principles of the Greek Nation with woke agendas and multiple books, it deceives our children and directs them away from patriotic knowledge, the value of the traditional family, and leads them to the deconstruction of our national and Greek Orthodox identity.
Democratic Patriotic Movement – Victory

GR2026-10-12#
party document Public statement

Η ΝΙΚΗ τίμησε τη μνήμη του Νικηταρά στο Χιλιομόδι Κορινθίας

NIKI party vice-president and MP Georgios Rountas attended a memorial ceremony for 1821 Greek Revolution hero Nikitaras in Chiliomodi, Corinthia, on 11 October 2026, laying a wreath and declaring that Greece must be liberated again in this critical era for the Greek nation.

Source metadataAI-assisted screening and summaryAI translationNot human-validated
Σήμερα τιμούμε τη μνήμη του τεράστιου αυτού ήρωα της θεόπνευστης Επανάστασης του 1821, του Νικήτα Σταματελόπουλου, του Νικηταρά. Σήμερα, σε αυτή την τόσο κρίσιμη εποχή για το έθνος των Ελλήνων, ευχόμαστε ολόψυχα ο καλός Θεός να γεμίσει τις καρδιές των Ελλήνων με το πύρωμα της ψυχής του μεγάλου αυτού ήρωα, του Νικηταρά, και να βοηθήσει να ελευθερωθεί και πάλι η Ελλάδα.
Today we honor the memory of this tremendous hero of the divinely inspired Revolution of 1821, Nikitas Stamatelopoulos, Nikitaras. Today, in this very critical era for the Greek nation, we wholeheartedly pray that the good God fills the hearts of Greeks with the fire of the soul of this great hero, Nikitaras, and helps Greece to be liberated once again.
Georgios Rountas
να παραδώσουμε στα παιδιά μας μια πατρίδα ελεύθερη, περήφανη και πιστή στις ιερές της παραδόσεις
to hand over to our children a homeland free, proud and faithful to its sacred traditions
NIKI

party document Public statement

Δ. Νατσιός από Κοζάνη: «Καρφί στα πλευρά της Μακεδονίας και ολόκληρου του ελληνικού έθνους η προδοσία των Πρεσπών»

Dimitris Natsios, president of NIKI party, attended the 114th anniversary of Kozani's liberation, laid a wreath, and criticized the Prespa Agreement as a betrayal of Macedonia and Greece, while also condemning Prime Minister Mitsotakis for declaring war on Russia and noting that NIKI submitted a bill in 2025 to abolish the Prespa Agreement.

Source metadataAI-assisted screening and summaryAI translationNot human-validated
Η μνήμη είναι το πιο ισχυρό αμυντήριο ενός έθνους. Ταυτόχρονα όμως είναι και διδασκαλείο. Μας διδάσκει η μνήμη, ότι η λευτεριά είναι κάστρο και το παίρνεις με το σπαθί σου και το δέντρο της ελευθερίας ποτίζεται με ποταμούς αίματος.
Memory is the most powerful defense of a nation. At the same time, however, it is also a school. Memory teaches us that freedom is a castle and you take it with your sword and the tree of freedom is watered with rivers of blood.
Dimitris Natsios
Αυτή η κηλίδα, αυτός ο λεκές πρέπει να φύγει από την ιστορία μας. Δυστυχώς, βρέθηκαν πριν από μερικά χρόνια οι Ιούδες, οι προδότες της Μακεδονίας, ο Τσίπρας και ο Κοτζιάς και η Νέα Δημοκρατία συνεχίζει να υποστηρίζει εμμέσως πλην σαφώς αυτή την προδοτική συμφωνία
This stain, this blemish must be removed from our history. Unfortunately, a few years ago the Judases were found, the traitors of Macedonia, Tsipras and Kotzias, and New Democracy continues to support indirectly but clearly this treasonous agreement
Dimitris Natsios

NIKH MP Aspasia Kouroupaki submitted a parliamentary question to the Ministers of Environment and Energy and Climate Crisis and Civil Protection demanding full disclosure on licensing, fire risks, and operational readiness regarding planned lithium battery storage facilities near residential areas in Arcadia.

Source metadataAI-assisted screening and summaryAI translationNot human-validated
Κάτοικοι φοβούνται πυρκαγιές και έκλυση τοξικών αερίων
Residents fear fires and release of toxic gases
NIKH (article title)
Οι κάτοικοι της Αρκαδίας έχουν δικαίωμα να γνωρίζουν τι σχεδιάζεται κοντά στα σπίτια και στις περιουσίες τους, ποιοι κίνδυνοι έχουν αξιολογηθεί και ποια ακριβώς μέτρα έχει προβλέψει η Πολιτεία για την προστασία της ζωής, της υγείας και του τόπου τους.

Giorgos Papailios, SYRIZA MP for Arcadia and sector head for Justice, Citizen Protection, Labour and Social Security, spoke at the 3rd Panhellenic Conference of Industrial Park Enterprises in Megalopoli about productive development and manufacturing support.

Source metadataAI-assisted screening and summaryAI translationNot human-validated
Δεν γίνεται συζήτηση απλώς για οικόπεδα, κτίρια, δίκτυα και άδειες. Γίνεται συζήτηση για το παραγωγικό μέλλον της χώρας: Για το πού θα παράγουμε, πώς θα στηρίξουμε τη μεταποίηση, ποιοι θα έχουν πρόσβαση στις υποδομές και, εν τέλει, ποιος θα καρπώνεται το προϊόν της ανάπτυξης.

Πώς θα αισθανόταν αλήθεια ο Ήρωας Παύλος Μελάς σήμερα, βλέποντας τον εθνομηδενιστικό ΣΥΡΙΖΑ να ξεπουλά στα Σκόπια το Όνομα, την Γλώσσα, την Ταυτότητα και την Ιστορία της Μακεδονίας μας, μέσω της κατάπτυστης Συμφωνίας των Πρεσπών;

12 Οκτωβρίου 1944 – Η απελευθέρωση της Αθήνας και η αρχή του τέλους για την Κατοχή της Ελλάδας από τους Ναζί

Voice of Reason and MEP Afroditi Latinopoulou issued a statement commemorating the 82nd anniversary of Athens' liberation from Nazi occupation on 12 October 1944, criticizing leftist claims that the communist EAM liberated Athens and emphasizing five milestones of the 1940s including the suppression of communist insurgency in December 1944 and August 1949.

Source metadataAI-assisted screening and summaryAI translationNot human-validated
Δεν είναι λίγοι όμως, εκείνοι που αυτοαποκαλούμενοι ως "φιλειρηνιστές", προερχόμενοι ασφαλώς από τον χώρο της Αριστεράς, τους υπερτονίζουν τα τελευταία χρόνια την σημασία της 12ης Οκτωβρίου 1944, προπαγανδίζοντας αναληθώς ότι το κομμουνιστικό Ε.Α.Μ. απελευθέρωσε την Αθήνα.
However, there are not few of those who call themselves 'pacifists', certainly coming from the Left, who in recent years overemphasize the significance of 12 October 1944, falsely propagandizing that the communist EAM liberated Athens.
Voice of Reason
Η ΦΩΝΗ ΛΟΓΙΚΗΣ και η Πρόεδρός της, Ευρωβουλευτής Αφροδίτη Λατινοπούλου, τιμούν, όπως και κάθε Έλληνας Πατριώτης τα 5 ορόσημα της Επικής Δεκαετίας του 1940
VOICE OF REASON and its President, MEP Afroditi Latinopoulou, honor, like every Greek Patriot, the 5 milestones of the Epic Decade of the 1940s
Voice of Reason

party document Public statement

Α. Λατινοπούλου: “Επίσκεψη Ρούμπιο: Μη τολμήσουν να χαραμίσουν άλλη μια εθνική ευκαιρία!”

Voice of Reason leader Afroditi Latinopoulou issued a statement criticizing the Greek government's handling of US Secretary of State Rubio's Athens visit, demanding exploitation of Greece's geopolitical position, restoration of national identity in education, strict border enforcement with immediate deportations of irregular migrants, and transparent defense procurement while deepening strategic cooperation with the United States.

Source metadataAI-assisted screening and summaryAI translationNot human-validated
Η επίσκεψη Ρούμπιο στην Αθήνα δεν μπορεί να καταλήξει σε ακόμη ένα διπλωματικό σόου με φωτογραφίες, δηλώσεις και επικοινωνιακές φιέστες.
Rubio's visit to Athens cannot end up as yet another diplomatic show with photographs, statements and communication festivities.
Afroditi Latinopoulou
Η ΦΩΝΗ ΛΟΓΙΚΗΣ τονίζει ότι η Ελλάδα οφείλει να επιστρέψει στις αξίες που γέννησαν τον ελληνικό πολιτισμό. Αυτή είναι η απάντηση στην παρακμή της woke ατζέντας, στον ανεξέλεγκτο δικαιωματισμό, στην αποδόμηση της εθνικής ταυτότητας και στην ανοχή απέναντι στη λαθρομετανάστευση.
VOICE OF REASON emphasizes that Greece must return to the values that gave birth to Greek civilization. This is the answer to the decline of the woke agenda, to uncontrolled rights-ism, to the deconstruction of national identity and to tolerance towards illegal immigration.
Voice of Reason

IE2026-10-09#
party document Public statement

People Power Forced Drumcree U-Turn

People Before Profit claims community mobilisation forced the Secretary of State to cancel a contested Orange Order march on Garvaghy Road, criticises the DUP and unionist elites for sectarian division, and calls for a socialist Ireland built by working-class unity across communities.

Source metadataAI-assisted screening and summaryNot human-validated
This didn't come from the Parades Commission, which folded the moment the DUP and the TUV turned up the pressure. It didn't come from the courts, which made a series of harried decisions through the night. Nor did it come from a Secretary of State who spent nearly a fortnight disingenuously insisting his hands were tied. It came from the community of the Garvaghy Road, as well as thousands of ordinary people standing with them over the past two weeks.
People Before Profit
The DUP can't build houses. It can't get people a hospital appointment. It can't deliver a single thing for the communities it claims to speak for. It reaches for sectarian division instead, because division is the only thing it has ever reliably produced.
People Before Profit

IT2026-10-15#
party document Public statement

Istat: povertà in calo, politiche governo efficaci

Brothers of Italy senators Guido Liris and Guerino Testa claim that ISTAT data showing poverty declining to 8% in 2025 and risk of poverty or social exclusion falling to 22.6% demonstrate the effectiveness of the Meloni government's policies including employment measures, tax cuts, and family support.

Source metadataAI-assisted screening and summaryAI translationNot human-validated
I dati diffusi oggi dall'Istat confermano che con il governo Meloni la povertà in Italia è in calo. La povertà assoluta è scesa all'8% nel 2025, rispetto all'8,4% del 2024 e all'8,3% del 2022.
The data released today by ISTAT confirm that under the Meloni government poverty in Italy is declining. Absolute poverty fell to 8% in 2025, compared to 8.4% in 2024 and 8.3% in 2022.
Guido Liris
Sono numeri che smentiscono ancora una volta la narrazione delle opposizioni e dimostrano che le politiche del governo stanno producendo risultati concreti: più occupazione stabile e a tempo pieno, sostegno ai redditi, riduzione dell'Irpef e del cuneo fiscale e misure a favore delle famiglie con figli.
These are numbers that once again refute the opposition's narrative and demonstrate that the government's policies are producing concrete results: more stable and full-time employment, income support, reduction of IRPEF and the tax wedge, and measures in favor of families with children.
Guido Liris

IT2026-10-07#
party document Policy proposal

Sanità: aumenti fino a 560 euro per personale medico

Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni announced contract renewal for healthcare workers bringing average monthly increases of 393 euros for over 137,000 medical personnel, with potential total increases up to 560 euros.

Source metadataAI-assisted screening and summaryAI translationNot human-validated
Un altro passo concreto per valorizzare chi ogni giorno si prende cura della salute degli italiani. Con il rinnovo del contratto 2025-2027 dell'Area Sanità, che riguarda oltre 137 mila medici e dirigenti sanitari, arrivano aumenti medi di 393 euro al mese per 13 mensilità, ai quali possono aggiungersi ulteriori risorse previste dalla legge, fino a un incremento complessivo di circa 560 euro.
Another concrete step to value those who every day take care of the health of Italians. With the renewal of the 2025-2027 contract for the Health Area, which concerns over 137 thousand doctors and health managers, average increases of 393 euros per month for 13 months are coming, to which additional resources provided by law can be added, up to a total increase of about 560 euros.
Giorgia Meloni
Continuiamo a investire sulle professionalità del nostro Servizio sanitario nazionale, riconoscendo il lavoro, le competenze e le responsabilità di chi ogni giorno garantisce assistenza e cure ai cittadini.
We continue to invest in the professionalism of our National Health Service, recognizing the work, skills and responsibilities of those who every day guarantee assistance and care to citizens.
Giorgia Meloni

Minister Francesco Lollobrigida announced the 'Cambiale Azzurra' program providing 10 million euros in zero-interest financing to fishing and aquaculture businesses, with loans up to 20,000-60,000 euros per enterprise, applications open October 13-30 via Ismea portal.

IT2026-10-17#
party document Mobilisation or protest

“Una cittadinanza senza confini”: lavoro, diritti, istruzione e pace

The Italian Communist Party organized two public assemblies in Iglesias and Sassari on October 16-17 titled "A citizenship without borders" to discuss migration, citizenship, labor rights, and social services, advocating for extending rights to all workers regardless of origin and criticizing detention centers in Sardinia.

Source metadataAI-assisted screening and summaryAI translationNot human-validated
L'iniziativa vuole mettere al centro una prospettiva che rifiuta la contrapposizione tra lavoratrici e lavoratori italiani e migranti.
The initiative aims to center a perspective that rejects the opposition between Italian and migrant workers.
Partito Comunista Italiano
Accettare che una parte della popolazione possa vivere e lavorare con meno diritti significa rendere più fragili i diritti di tutti.
Accepting that a part of the population can live and work with fewer rights means making everyone's rights more fragile.
Partito Comunista Italiano

IT2026-10-16#
party document Alliance or coordination

Siderurgia, il rischio di chiusura non è una fatalità. A Genova come a Taranto, serve una politica industriale pubblica, non il riarmo

The Italian Communist Party expresses full support for steelworkers occupying the Prefecture in Genoa-Cornigliano and calls for nationalization of strategic steel assets and public industrial policy instead of military spending, criticizing decades of privatization and neoliberal policies.

Source metadataAI-assisted screening and summaryAI translationNot human-validated
Il Partito Comunista Italiano esprime pieno sostegno e solidarietà alle lavoratrici e ai lavoratori di Cornigliano che hanno occupato la Prefettura per difendere il proprio futuro e quello della siderurgia genovese.
The Italian Communist Party expresses full support and solidarity with the workers of Cornigliano who have occupied the Prefecture to defend their future and that of Genoese steelmaking.
Partito Comunista Italiano
Per il nostro Partito, l'unica strada seria è il ritorno a una presenza pubblica forte e diretta nella siderurgia, attraverso la nazionalizzazione degli asset strategici e il finanziamento degli investimenti necessari a rilanciare la produzione di acciaio.
For our Party, the only serious path is the return to a strong and direct public presence in steelmaking, through the nationalization of strategic assets and financing of the necessary investments to relaunch steel production.
Partito Comunista Italiano

Il PCI di Empoli in piazza per Iyad Taha e per il popolo palestinese

The Italian Communist Party section in Empoli organized a protest on 12 October 2026 in solidarity with the Palestinian people and mourning the killing of Iyad Taha by Israeli forces, demanding severance of ties with Israel, BDS measures, and opposition to an anti-semitism bill they characterize as targeting anti-Zionism.

Source metadataAI-assisted screening and summaryAI translationNot human-validated
Interruzione di ogni rapporto economico, militare e politico con Israele; Boicottaggio, Disinvestimento, Sanzioni contro i prodotti israeliani venduti in Italia; NO ALL'APPROVAZIONE DEL DDL 'ANTISEMITISMO', CHE PUNISCE NON L'ANTISEMITISMO MA L'ANTISIONISMO E OGNI CRITICA AL GOVERNO DI ISRAELE.
Interruption of all economic, military and political relations with Israel; Boycott, Divestment, Sanctions against Israeli products sold in Italy; NO TO THE APPROVAL OF THE 'ANTI-SEMITISM' BILL, WHICH PUNISHES NOT ANTI-SEMITISM BUT ANTI-ZIONISM AND ANY CRITICISM OF THE GOVERNMENT OF ISRAEL.
Sandro Scardigli

IT2026-10-09#
party document Public statement

PCI: Melonellum, le ombre della legge Acerbo e i rischi per la democrazia. DIFENDIAMO LA COSTITUZIONE!

The Italian Communist Party condemns the proposed electoral law (dubbed 'Melonellum') as unconstitutional, drawing parallels to the 1923 Acerbo law that facilitated fascism, and pledges to defend the Constitution through political and legal challenges.

Source metadataAI-assisted screening and summaryAI translationNot human-validated
Le similitudini con la legge Acerbo del 1923 non possono essere liquidate come un semplice richiamo storico. Quella legge assegnava i due terzi dei seggi alla lista più votata che avesse superato il 25% dei voti validi, contribuendo a consegnare al fascismo una maggioranza parlamentare schiacciante dopo le elezioni del 1924.
The similarities with the Acerbo law of 1923 cannot be dismissed as a simple historical reference. That law assigned two-thirds of the seats to the most-voted list that exceeded 25% of valid votes, contributing to delivering to fascism an overwhelming parliamentary majority after the 1924 elections.
Italian Communist Party
Il PCI non accetterà che il pluralismo venga sacrificato sull'altare della governabilità o che la sovranità popolare venga svuotata da regole costruite a vantaggio di chi detiene già il potere.
The PCI will not accept that pluralism be sacrificed on the altar of governability or that popular sovereignty be emptied by rules constructed to advantage those who already hold power.
Italian Communist Party

NO2026-10-08#
party document Public statement

– Som å tro på julenissen

Progress Party leader Sylvi Listhaug criticizes the Labour Party government's budget, claiming tax cuts are offset by increased electricity price surcharges, and proposes FrP's alternative of tax cuts, halving food VAT, and reducing fuel taxes.

Source metadataAI-assisted screening and summaryAI translationNot human-validated
Å tro at Arbeiderpartiet kutter skatter og avgifter er som å tro på julenissen
To believe that the Labour Party cuts taxes and fees is like believing in Santa Claus
Sylvi Listhaug
Regjeringen har forsøkt å skape et inntrykk av at de gir folk skattelette, men øker avgifter og Norgespris på strøm som gjør at svært mange sitter igjen med mindre i lommeboka. Frp vil kutte skattene, halvere matmomsen og redusere drivstoffavgiftene for å gi folk mer økonomisk handlefrihet
The government has tried to create an impression that they are giving people tax relief, but increases fees and the Norway price on electricity which means that very many are left with less in their wallet. FrP will cut taxes, halve the food VAT and reduce fuel taxes to give people more economic freedom
Sylvi Listhaug

The Portuguese Communist Party proposes an 80-euro increase in all pensions and the Solidarity Supplement for the Elderly starting January 1st, a 5% minimum increase, raising minimum pension values, creating two new tiers for longer contributory careers, and calculating the Solidarity Supplement individually rather than penalizing couples.

Source metadataAI-assisted screening and summaryAI translationNot human-validated
O PCP defende que a partir de 1 de Janeiro todas as reformas e pensões tenham um aumento de 5% com um mínimo de 80 euros.
The PCP defends that from January 1st all pensions have an increase of 5% with a minimum of 80 euros.
Partido Comunista Português
É preciso denunciar a falsidade dos argumentos do Governo segundo os quais não é possível avançar com aumentos substanciais das reformas pensões, porque é preciso preservar o equilíbrio financeiro da Segurança Social.
It is necessary to denounce the falsity of the Government's arguments according to which it is not possible to advance with substantial increases in pensions, because it is necessary to preserve the financial balance of Social Security.
Partido Comunista Português

party document Parliamentary intervention

Partido Comunista Português

Paulo Raimundo delivered a parliamentary interpellation on 16 October 2026 criticizing government policy on housing, wages, healthcare, education, and privatization, and calling for participation in a CGTP demonstration the following day.

Source metadataAI-assisted screening and summaryAI translationNot human-validated
O PCP avança hoje com esta interpelação com o objectivo de debater a realidade da vida, na falta de respostas às dificuldades e aos problemas crescentes, uma interpelação de confronto com uma política errada que precisa de ser travada.
The PCP advances today with this interpellation with the objective of debating the reality of life, in the absence of responses to growing difficulties and problems, an interpellation confronting a wrong policy that needs to be stopped.
Paulo Raimundo
Como estaria o País se em vez de uma política egoísta, violenta e ao serviço da especulação imobiliária e dos especuladores, onde rendas de 2300 euros são consideradas moderadas, houvesse uma verdadeira política de habitação?
How would the country be if instead of a selfish, violent policy serving real estate speculation and speculators, where rents of 2300 euros are considered moderate, there was a true housing policy?
Paulo Raimundo

PCP Secretary-General Paulo Raimundo delivered a speech on 15 October 2026 in Amadora condemning the 2027 State Budget as an assault on workers' lives, calling for mobilisation including demonstrations on 17 October in Porto, Coimbra and Lisbon, and opposing the privatisation of TAP to Lufthansa.

Source metadataAI-assisted screening and summaryAI translationNot human-validated
estamos perante um assalto. Cada um que reflicta, cada um que olhe para trás e veja se há ou não uns poucos que, independentemente de pandemias, guerras, frio ou calor, chuva ou nevoeiro, concentram sempre mais riqueza à custa dos muitos que pagam sempre a factura.
we are facing an assault. Let each one reflect, let each one look back and see whether or not there are a few who, regardless of pandemics, wars, cold or heat, rain or fog, always concentrate more wealth at the expense of the many who always pay the bill.

PT2026-10-14#
party document Public statement

Partido Comunista Português

The Portuguese Communist Party condemned the government's decision to sell 49.9% of TAP airline to Lufthansa for 1.201 billion euros, calling it an economic crime and antipatriotic decision, and pledged to take parliamentary initiatives to reverse the privatization.

Source metadataAI-assisted screening and summaryAI translationNot human-validated
O Governo anunciou hoje que foi a Lufthansa quem ganhou o processo de privatização da TAP, preparando-se agora esta para tomar o controlo da TAP e de 49,9% do seu capital. Esta decisão, na sequência de outras tentativas de privatização da TAP realizadas ao longo dos anos, é um crime contra a economia nacional que pode e deve ser travado.
The Government announced today that Lufthansa won the TAP privatization process, now preparing to take control of TAP and 49.9% of its capital. This decision, following other attempts to privatize TAP over the years, is a crime against the national economy that can and must be stopped.
Portuguese Communist Party
O Governo decidiu vender a maior empresa do País, por uma verba inferior – 1201 milhões de euros - àquilo que todos os anos oferece em benefícios fiscais ao grande capital.
The Government decided to sell the country's largest company for an amount – 1,201 million euros – lower than what it offers annually in tax benefits to big capital.
Portuguese Communist Party
